payload.text: hv, 2026-11-04, four rulings asked in vc's session, each the recommended option: (1) one picture rule, first by name: pplr pictures and the index take what tree::PICTURES finds, a ruled divergence in CHANGELOG 2.0.1 (ST0003 WP05).
